input.prompt: Keep this black and white linocut image exactly identical: same composition, same people, same lines. Add only the signs of the plague, printed in vivid blood red, the only color in the whole image: a large swollen bubo on the side of the man's neck just under the jaw, and a few dark red blotches on the backs of his hands. Everything else stays pure black and white.

Completely re-render this close-up photograph in the style described below, keeping the same framing: the side of a man's unshaven neck with a swollen, dark purplish-red lump (a plague bubo) clearly visible, the collar of his dark-blue work jacket, and the black leather glove pulling the collar aside. Make the skin look sickly and the lump the focal point. No text, no signature.
STYLE: a 1970s European underground comic panel: bold black brush-ink outlines, expressive scratchy crosshatching, flat muted colors with no gradients (mustard, olive green, brick red, dirty beige), halftone dots in the shadows.
